Location: Santa Monica, California (in-person; local candidates only — no relocation)
Minarc is a Santa Monica architecture and design studio working at the intersection of sustainability, craft, and resilience. For more than twenty-five years we have designed buildings that are as thoughtful in their detailing as they are in their ideas. Our current work centers on non-combustible steel construction and wildfire rebuild projects across the Palisades and greater Los Angeles, alongside an ongoing residential portfolio.
Salary range: $70,000 – $95,000 per year, commensurate with experience.
We are looking for a drafter who wants to do this work well — someone who cares about a clean set and a well-resolved detail, not just pushing lines. You will produce construction documents and 3D models in ArchiCAD, develop details, and carry projects alongside our team from schematic design through construction documents. This is a hands-on role with real responsibility: you will work directly with the principals on projects that get built, and your judgment and craft will show in the work.
Requirements:
How to apply: Send résumé and portfolio/work samples (PDF or link) to [email protected] with "ArchiCAD Drafter" in the subject line.
Minarc Architecture + Design is an equal opportunity employer.
